mapper.sql: p.project_id, p.project_no, p.project_name, p.owner_user_id, p.dept_id, p.summary, p.research_objectives, p.research_content, p.start_date, p.planned_end_date, p.total_budget, p.progress, p.status, p.expected_deliverables, p.create_by, p.create_time, p.update_by, p.update_time, p.remark, u.nick_name owner_name, d.dept_name, coalesce((select sum(e.amount) from research_expense e where e.project_id = p.project_id), 0) used_budget
mapper.select:
select from research_project p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.owner_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id
and p.owner_user_id = #{ownerUserId} and p.status = #{status}
and (p.project_name like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%') or p.project_no like concat('%', #{keyword}, '%'))
order by p.update_time desc, p.project_id desc
select from research_project p left join sys_user u on u.user_id = p.owner_user_id left join sys_dept d on d.dept_id = p.dept_id where p.project_id = #{projectId} limit 1
mapper.update: update research_project set status = #{status}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where project_id = #{projectId}
update research_project set progress = #{progress}, update_by = #{updateBy}, update_time = sysdate() where project_id = #{projectId}
